data.title: Elie Saab VIE
data.about:
A beautiful community setting is combined with contemporary architecture in this ELIE SAAB project, one of its prestigious projects. 

With the ELIE SAAB VIE at The Fields residents, life is defined by eloquence and comfort. This new development offers residents a choice of luxurious 4 bedroom townhouses. The best of Dubai is all in one location, complete with activities and amenities to ensure smooth transitions between work, life, and recreation.

location_tile.title: An exclusive gated community nestles in the heart of Meydan A short drive from Downtown Dubai.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
With easy access to major highways and Dubai landmarks, it is well located throughout the city.

  • 10 Mins – Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 12 Mins – District One Crystal Lagoon
  • 15 Mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 20 Mins – Mall of The Emirates
  • 20 Mins – International Airport
